subject: Aurora private deployment: runbook access, egress window & commercial ask
messages:
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwoodinference.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@aegis-analytics.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Aurora private deployment - initial runbook & audit scope questions

Hi Daniel,

Thanks for the productive call this morning. Attached is the draft SOW and the initial security addendum we discussed (Aegis_SOW_initial.pdf). A few follow-ups from our side so we can scope the Private (VPC) deployment and give a concrete plan: 

- Runbook access: you asked for temporary operational runbook access during onboarding for troubleshooting. Can you confirm which engineers will need access and whether read-only vs read/write is required?
- Egress window: you mentioned allowing a limited outbound egress window for data migrations and remote debugging. Please confirm the expected dates and IP ranges if you have them.
- Audit requests: please list the specific evidence you need (SOC 2 report, penetration test, KMS attestations). We can provide SOC 2 Type II redacted and a SOC summary; full raw logs require an approved scope and NDA.

If you can send your procurement contact and any example contract clauses you need redlined, I’ll loop in our legal and deal desk. Goal is to make the onboarding smooth while preserving our security posture.

Thanks,
Nikhil Sharma
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
nikhil.sharma@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0134

Attachment: Aegis_SOW_initial.pdf
From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@aegis-analytics.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@aegis-analytics.com
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Aurora private deployment - initial runbook & audit scope questions

Nikhil,

Appreciate the docs. Quick answers from Aegis side: 

- Engineers: two platform engineers (Daniel Park and Priya Reddy) will need runbook access for the first 90 days of onboarding. Read-only is fine for most material but we will request temporary privileged support sessions with an engineer for escalations.
- Egress window: we need to push an initial data migration on 2026-10-01 to 2026-10-03 that will require outbound connections to our SFTP endpoints (IP ranges attached). This is strictly for migration; after that we expect minimal egress.
- Audit evidence: procurement is requesting SOC 2 Type II, pen-test summary, and the ability to run a one-time vendor audit with 30 days’ notice. We also would like the operational runbook (redacted for secrets) for our infra team to validate patch/maintenance windows.

Commercial note: procurement is asking for a 25% concession on first-year committed fees in exchange for a 24-month contract and rapid go-live (they have an internal deadline).

Attaching our security questionnaire for your legal team to review (Aegis_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx).

Thanks,
Daniel Park
Director, Platform Engineering
Aegis Analytics
daniel.park@aegis-analytics.com

Attachment: Aegis_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 17 Sep 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Aegis - runbook access + egress window + pricing concession (need exec/dealdesk input)

Folks, forwarding Aegis’ asks below. TL;DR: 

- Runbook access request: read-only runbook for two engineers + occasional privileged session. They want it for 90 days.
- Audit: SOC2 Type II + one-time on-site/vendor audit with 30 days notice.
- Egress: 2026-10-01 -> 2026-10-03 migration window to allow outbound connections to specified IPs (SFTP).
- Commercial: they’re asking for 25% off year-1 in exchange for 24-month contract and an aggressive go-live.

My read: runbook can be provided in redacted form with strict access controls and full session logging. One-time vendor audit is sensitive but can be scoped (we typically offer evidence & hosted audit with an observer; on-site or raw log access needs legal/exec sign-off). The egress window for a small, timeboxed migration seems manageable with guardrails (limited source IPs, jumpbox, and least-privilege agreement).

Requesting:
- Deal desk approval on a pricing concession (recommendation: up to 18% year-1 discount if we get 24-month commitment + target MRR).
- Legal sign-off on a one-time, timeboxed audit clause with NDA + redaction rules.
- Exec sign-off for the egress exception limited to 72 hours and logged by our ops team.

Attachments: Aegis_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx (from customer), Aegis_SOW_initial.pdf

Thanks,
Nikhil

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 18 Sep 2026 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Aegis - runbook access + egress window + pricing concession (need exec/dealdesk input)

Team,

Reviewed the questionnaire and the SOW. Legal position and recommended carveouts below: 

1) Runbook access: provide a redacted operational runbook (no credentials, no internal IP diagrams that reveal other customers). Access to be read-only via a shared, audited S3 bucket with time-limited pre-signed URLs and MFA for external engineers. Privileged support sessions allowed only with a Redwood engineer present and recorded. Limit duration: 90 days post-go-live.

2) Audit: decline raw-system-level access or copying of logs offsite. Offer: SOC 2 Type II redacted report, pen-test summary, and a supervised vendor audit where Redwood hosts the session and provides agreed-upon evidence for a maximum of 4 hours. Customer may observe but not extract logs. Require a mutual NDA and a narrow statement of scope.

3) Egress window: approve a 72-hour, timeboxed outbound window for IPs provided. Conditions: (a) pre-approved IP list, (b) egress only to named endpoints, (c) all activity captured in our VPC flow logs and retained for 180 days, (d) an agreed rollback plan, (e) Redwood reserves right to terminate window for suspicious activity.

4) Pricing concession: legal neutral but recommend deal desk limits discount authority. If commercial approves any concession, include non-refundable onboarding fee and strict SLA definitions.

Next steps: I’ll send redlined SOW (redlines_Aegis_SOW.pdf) with the clauses above. If deal desk/exec agree on the commercial path, we can send the one-time-access procedures and the NDA for their signature.

-Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: redlines_Aegis_SOW.pdf
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Sep 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Aegis - runbook access + egress window + pricing concession (need exec/dealdesk input)

Team,

Decision: approved with the following commercial and operational conditions. Please use the language below when responding to Aegis.

Commercial:
- Approved concession: 18% off first-year committed fees on a 24-month term (no further discounting). Non-refundable onboarding fee of $25k to cover privileged-access staffing.

Operational / Security:
- Runbook: provide redacted read-only runbook via secure S3 with pre-signed links; access expires 90 days after go-live. Privileged sessions only with Redwood engineer present and recorded.
- Audit: provide SOC 2 Type II redacted report and pen-test summary. One supervised vendor audit (up to 4 hours) allowed on 30 days’ notice under mutual NDA; no raw log extraction.
- Egress window: approve 72-hour migration window 2026-10-01 to 2026-10-03 to listed IPs only; all traffic logged and monitored; we will suspend the window if any anomalous behavior detected.

Rationale: this preserves our security posture while enabling the migration and a predictable commercial commitment. Please update SOW and run the DocuSign with these redlines. Also include the onboarding fee and the confirmation of monitoring responsibilities.

Approved by: Rishi Malhotra (Deal Desk) and Stephanie Nguyen (VP Sales)

Action for Nikhil/Marissa: send a response to Aegis summarizing the conditions and attach the redlined SOW + NDA. I’ll prep the final concession memo for finance.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Manager, Deal Desk, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@aegis-analytics.com>, procurement@aegis-analytics.com
Cc: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Sep 2026 10:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Aurora private deployment - approved conditions and next steps

Daniel — thanks for the patience. Following internal review, Redwood can proceed under the conditions below: 

1) Commercial: 18% off year-1 committed fees on a 24-month term. A non-refundable $25,000 onboarding fee payable at DocuSign execution.
2) Runbook: redacted, read-only runbook provided via secure S3 links; access is for two named engineers and expires 90 days after go-live. Privileged sessions permitted only with a Redwood engineer present and recorded.
3) Audit: Redwood will provide SOC 2 Type II redacted report and pen-test summary. A supervised vendor audit (max 4 hours) is permitted with 30 days’ notice under mutual NDA; no log extraction offsite.
4) Egress window: Approved 72-hour migration window (2026-10-01 to 2026-10-03) only to IPs you provided. Redwood will monitor traffic; we reserve the right to suspend transfer on suspicious activity.

Please confirm acceptance of these conditions so we can send the redlined SOW + NDA and DocuSign for signature. Once countersigned and onboarding fee is paid, we’ll schedule the migration and runbook handover.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
